    if any(ws.cell(r, c).value is not None for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1)):

    first_used = min(used_rows)
    last_used = max(used_rows)

    last_used = ws.max_row

header_row = first_used

            if src.protection:
                dest.protection = copy(src.protection)
